title: International Neuromorphic Computing Conference 2027
summary: NeuroSYNC announces the International Neuromorphic Computing Conference (INCC) for May 11–13, 2027 in London. Organized by NeuroSYNC with co-organizers NeuMat and NeuroWare, the event targets researchers and industry leaders to advance brain-inspired computing topics including photonics and unconventional systems.
tldr: NeuroSYNC launches INCC 2027 as a multidisciplinary gathering for neuromorphic computing in London from May 11–13, 2027.
evidence: NeuroSYNC is delighted to announce the launch of the International Neuromorphic Computing Conference (INCC) 2027... Taking place from 11–13 May 2027 at Mercure London Earls Court, London, UK
Led by NeuroSYNC – UK Multidisciplinary Centre for Neuromorphic Systems and Computing, and co-organised by NeuMat ... and NeuroWare
